name: Orendil's Cure
summary: In northern Ashenvale, Orendil Broadleaf brews a draught for a child in Astranaar. He uses rare Bathran's Hair to treat Relara Whitemoon's mysterious, deathly sickness.

sections.title: A Father's Hope
sections.body: Relara Whitemoon, still young, fell deathly ill in Astranaar, and ordinary remedies failed. Her father, Pelturas Whitemoon, sought help from Orendil Broadleaf, a hermit and master of natural medicine who lives in northern Ashenvale. Orendil used bundles of rare Bathran's Hair gathered from the haunted ruins of Bathran's Haunt to brew a draught for Relara. When the vial arrives, it gives Pelturas hope. Yet the cure only slows the disease, so he must seek the further remedies Orendil suggested.

faq.q: What is Orendil's Cure used for?
faq.answer: Orendil's Cure is meant to soothe and treat Relara Whitemoon, a young night elf child in Astranaar. Her sudden, severe illness has left her stricken.
Orendil Broadleaf prepared the cure. He is a reclusive night elf herbalist in Ashenvale's northern woods, renowned for his mastery of forest plants and remedies.

faq.q: What ingredients were used to make it?
faq.answer: The cure uses Bathran's Hair, a delicate, uncommon plant gathered among the ruins of Bathran's Haunt in northern Ashenvale.

faq.q: Does this potion completely heal the child?
faq.answer: No. Pelturas learns that Orendil's Cure only slows the disease afflicting his daughter, so he seeks the stronger remedy Orendil suggested: Elune's Tear.

angles.text: Ashenvale's native plants hold great medicinal power. Bathran's Hair is one such herb, growing only in select, shadowed corners of the forest.
For night elves in Astranaar, saving Relara is an urgent matter for the community. Hermits like Orendil bring woodland knowledge, while faith in Elune brings divine aid.
